followup_reviews.Separate challenger: GPT-6 Astra Pro /root/verification_recovery, separate same-model context
followup_reviews.Research finding: Intentional Thai passenger restrictions and the Sadao pilot occurred. The parent remains included; the proposal changes duration eligibility, not occurrence. The parent is a national umbrella, but the timed phase concerns ordinary non-repatriation passenger admission at Sadao. Freight, screened drivers and limited Thai returns are exceptions. The observed endpoint cannot be transferred to all Thai land borders. Restrictions were in place by 23 March 2020 and earlier local measures are evidenced. The first Sadao denial for the selected cohort is not directly dated. Propose withholding a complete operational duration while retaining the observed 1 April 2022 pilot endpoint and the by-23-March marker. Health and biosecurity / Human disease control is explicitly supported by the relayed official pandemic purpose. Other reasons are not inferred. Bernama diplomatic reporting, local pilot reporting, a later official MFA briefing and the earlier Xinhua report were read. The original Songkhla article and IOM PDF failed; an attributed indexed reproduction is identified as such. The phase is unlocated. Nong Khai reporting concerns Laos, not Cambodia. Proposed descriptive examples use freshly inspected evidence without making new geometry claims or treating national permission as opposite-side operation.
followup_reviews.Challenge verdict: Accepted within the root decision; see frozen challenge
followup_reviews.Challenge finding: Challenge packet SHA-256: 75f71973a192fafd898d69eee3f642a94b186f28c8ab91f32c95fb2d2560df1a. Per-question challenge findings remain in that packet.
followup_reviews.Root decision: Accept the full fixed sample audit of 16 parents and 27 phases, including 29 guarded input-cell corrections and the new Sadao onset question. Withdraw the unsupported Beitbridge cargo endpoint and exact Sadao duration, retain the Benapole quarantine, recognise the observed Rumichaca reopening and append the accessible Korala report. Apply the challenger’s medical-visa cohort, shared-reporting inference and unread-translation metadata refinements. Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
followup_reviews.Issue dispositions: REC50-R05-BQ06 — Recover the first local denial/order and establish the selected passenger cohort before reinstating an exact complete duration. This is an explicit challenge to the prior qualified-duration decision and requires separate adjudication.

Unknown dates, continuity, exceptions, missing source access and geographic limits remain explicit. This is a completed audit procedure for the sample, not a certification that all attributes are known or that the full register has been freshly verified.
